decks.notes: This deck utilizes a combination of cards to quickly and efficiently loop through its library to find key combo pieces. It focuses on using Underworld Breach alongside Grinding Station and other artifacts to generate infinite loops and win conditions. The deck also includes disruption and card draw to help protect the combo and find the necessary pieces. The goal is to assemble the combo quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful and unstoppable combo finish.

This deck focuses on utilizing lands and mana ramp spells to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. By using cards like Amulet of Vigor and Green Sun's Zenith, the deck can accelerate into its combo pieces and win conditions like Scapeshift and Malevolent Rumble. The main goal is to search for key lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, while using cards like Aftermath Analyst and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect and support the combo. The deck creates explosive turns and aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and combo chains.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature spells with powerful abilities, utilizing cards like Phalia, Ajani, and Ragavan to put pressure on the opponent. It includes cards like Ocelot Pride and Guide of Souls to buff your creatures and create a wide board presence. The deck also includes burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to deal direct damage to the opponent and control the board. With a mix of creatures, burn spells, and board control, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate infinite mana and mill your opponents out. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thundertrap Trainer help you dig for key pieces, while Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal provide additional mana acceleration. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Flame of Anor and Flare of Denial. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key artifacts, while Thassa's Oracle provides an alternate win condition. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Lotus Field. The goal is to efficiently search for key combo pieces like Primeval Titan and Scapeshift to establish a dominant board presence. By utilizing cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Summoner's Pact, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and land triggers. Key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle provide additional win conditions, making the deck versatile and able to adapt to different game states.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with burn spells and creature removal to quickly overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their game plan. The key strategy is to maintain a strong board presence through efficient creature attacks and utilize burn spells to finish off opponents or remove key threats. The deck also includes some control elements, such as Static Prison, to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive playstyle while also providing access to necessary colors for spells and abilities.

This deck aims to utilize Underworld Breach in combination with Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble to mill cards from the opponent's library and deal damage through Malevolent Rumble and Grapeshot. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Emry, Lurker of the Loch provide card advantage and graveyard recursion, while cards like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga help with mana acceleration and searching for key pieces. The deck also includes some control elements like Pithing Needle and Lightning Bolt to handle opposing threats. The strategy revolves around assembling the combo pieces quickly to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck revolves around utilizing Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to combo off and win the game. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help in finding combo pieces and fueling the engine. The deck also includes cards like Thassa's Oracle and Mishra's Bauble for additional card selection and win condition. Using various artifacts and mana acceleration, the deck aims to assemble the combo quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.Overall, the main goal is to create a loop where you can continuously mill through your entire deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It utilizes a combination of powerful creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, supported by efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames. The deck also takes advantage of Leyline synergy to maintain board control and apply pressure on the opponent. By efficiently utilizing its mana base and diverse creature pool, this deck aims to consistently apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on aggressive red/white creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It aims to put pressure on the opponent early with efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, supported by cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Seasoned Pyromancer. Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury serves as a powerful finisher to close out the game. The deck also includes some disruptive elements like Static Prison to control the board and protect its creatures. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through a combination of creature damage and burn spells.

The main idea of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of powerful creatures and burn spells. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide strong creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Guide of Souls support them with additional abilities. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride offer early aggression, while Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment provide direct damage. Static Prison and Arena of Glory help control the board, while leveraging the mana base with Arid Mesa and Flooded Strand ensures consistent access to the right colors of mana.

This deck relies on using various combinations of cards, such as Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Grinding Station, and Underworld Breach, to quickly mill through the deck and win the game by either decking out the opponent or comboing off to win with Thassa's Oracle. The key strategy is to use the graveyard as a resource to continuously loop spells and artifacts, generating advantage and digging deeper into the deck to find the necessary pieces to execute the combo and achieve victory.

This deck utilizes the combo potential of Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to achieve a powerful win condition. Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, and Mishra's Bauble provide card advantage and help to set up the combo. Mox Opal and Mox Amber aid in mana acceleration, while Urza's Saga helps to tutor for key pieces. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Swan Song to protect the combo. Overall, the strategy focuses on quickly assembling the combo pieces and winning the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on using ramp and control elements to quickly bring out powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. Cards like Through the Breach allow for explosive plays, while Chalice of the Void disrupts opponents' strategies. Yggdrasil, Rebirth Engine offers recursion and flexibility, while Devourer of Destiny provides a strong early game threat. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with massive Eldrazi creatures and efficient mana ramp, utilizing a mix of removal, disruption, and big threats to control the game and win through sheer power.

The deck focuses on maximizing the aggression of creatures through the use of blinking effects to generate additional value. By repeatedly flickering creatures like Boggart Trawler and Emperor of Bones, the deck can overwhelm opponents quickly. This strategy is supported by disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board while also utilizing powerful enchantments such as Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Witch Enchanter for additional synergy. The deck also includes graveyard hate like Relic of Progenitus and card advantage with Ephemerate to ensure consistent pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and utilizing blink effects to maximize their abilities. By blinking creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Overlord of the Balemurk, players can generate extra value and overwhelm opponents with a mix of powerful creatures and disruptive spells. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending to control the board while Thoughtseize helps disrupt opponents' game plans. Overall, the strategy is to apply pressure early, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and maintain board control through a combination of aggressive creatures and blink effects.
